# Weaver Tree Strategies

by VisionGLLast Updated: May 6, 2026

### Advertisement

This website is supported by ads.

Weaver Tree Strategies involve learning about all aspects of setting up your Weaver Tree and then applying that to farm mechanics more efficiently. Your first step is raising your Rank with the Woven Faction and completing Woven Echoes to obtain all 53 Weaver Points. After that, you apply the points to build an efficient Weaver Tree, which you can use to farm any mechanic in Last Epoch. This guide covers everything from a Strarter Strategy to advanced farming techniques.

## Gaining Weaver Tree Points

Weaver Tree Strategies
There are 53 Total Weaver Points available to use on your Weaver Tree. You collect these through a combination of raising your Faction Rank with The Woven and completing Woven Echoes. Most Woven Echoes are available through The Woven Faction or dropped naturally in Tombs and Cemeteries of the Erased. The remaining four Woven Echoes are only available as random drops.

### The Woven Faction and Every Woven Echo Point

Raising your Faction Rank with The Woven gives a Total of 13 Weaver Tree Points. Ranks 1 through 8 give 1 Weaver Tree Point each. Rank 9 gives 2 Points, and Rank 10 gives 3 Points.

In addition to gaining Weaver Tree Points with each new Faction Rank, you also gain access to purchasable Woven Echoes. Use these to target Woven Echoes where you are missing Passive Points. Outside of this, Woven Echoes are found as random drops in Tombs and Cemeteries of the Erased.

Each of these gives 1 Weaver Tree Point. The exception to this is the Tomb of Vessels and The Fading Brink Woven Echoes, which give 2 Weaver Tree Points each.

Aside from the Woven Echoes that are purchased for Memory Amber, four additional Woven Echoes are drop-only. The Drop Chance for each of these scale based on your Corruption level.

- Collapsing Horizon - (20-40%) Drop Chance from Timeline Bosses.
- The Fading Brink - (10-20%) Drop Chance from Timeline Harbingers.

The Starter Weaver Tree Strategy focuses on increasing your Woven Echo drops. This helps you to quickly gain your Weaver Points when first starting out.

## Using Imprinted Woven Echoes

Weaver Tree Strategies
Several of the Weaver Tree Strategies in this guide make use of Imprinted Woven Echoes to target specific mechanics. It's important to note here some specifics of Imprinted Woven Echoes.

First, you do not gain additional benefits from Imprinting multiples of the same Woven Example. For example, using your two Woven Echo Imprints on False Temple does not make them any more likely to appear than using just one Imprinted False Temple. For this reason, it is best to Imprint two different Woven Echoes.

Secondly, Imprinted Woven Echoes are more likely to appear within 10 Echoes of the center of the Echo Web, as Shade of Orobyss begins spawning beyond that point and competes for those spawns. For this reason, any Weaver Tree strategy that relies on farming a specific Imprinted Woven Echo wants to reset its Echo Web often to check for Woven Echo spawns. This is done on demand using the Sanctuary of Eterra Echo, near the center of the Echo Web. This needs to be balanced with occasionally killing the Shade of Orobyss to maintain your desired Corruption Level.

Sanctuary of Eterra

The Memories of the Observer Passive opens more visible space for Imprinted Echoes to spawn with Echo Chains. Weaver Tree Strategies that rely on Imprinted Woven Echoes use this to rapidly check for Imprinted Echoes. If no Imprinted Woven Echoes spawn, use the Sanctuary of Eterra to reset the Echo Web and try again. This process creates an easy way to fish for your desired Woven Echo Imprints.

Potential Imprint Slots Near Echo Chains

## Fury and Fortune

Weaver Tree Strategies
Fury and Fortune is a Passive in the Weaver Tree that causes enemies to drop more Runes and Glyphs, at the cost of making them permanently Enraged. Since Enrage gives enemies 35% increased Movement Speed and 60% increased Attack and Cast Speed, this makes them much more deadly than usual. To reach this node, you must path through Warden's Echo, which also adds dangerous dungeon enemies to your Echoes.

Since the rewards from Fury and Fortune are so great, all Weaver Tree Strategies below include this node. Be aware of these dangerous enemies when playing Hardcore. Consider removing these nodes if you notice you are dying frequently to Enraged or Dungeon Enemies, or if you are worried that your Character is not ready for this increased difficulty.

Fury and Fortune

## Choosing Your Strategy

Weaver Tree Strategies
There are several Weaver Tree Strategies to choose from, each with its own specialties. Choosing the right Weaver Tree strategy for your needs is important, as many of the strategies lock out certain mechanics to make your chosen mechanic more efficient. The Weaver Tree itself can be respecced at any time using Memory Amber, but selecting the best strategy for what you are trying to accomplish saves you time and resources.

### The Weaver Tree Strategies and Their Purpose

Here is a list of every Weaver Tree strategy in this Guide, and what purpose they serve. Check the list below for the appropriate Weaver Tree strategy for you, and navigate to it easily using the Table of Contents.

- Starter Strategy
- The Starter Weaver Tree Strategy is set up to quickly acquire all of your Weaver Tree Points. It is specialized to give you as many Woven Echo drops as possible, while keeping a variety of mechanics available for general farming. Use this strategy to collect and complete Woven Echoes for Points while gearing up your Character through the early stages. This is the intended Weaver Tree for players starting fresh who need to collect all their Weaver Tree Points to access more advanced strategies.

- General End Game Strategy
- This strategy removes the Passives supporting Woven Echo drops in exchange for more efficient item drops. It enhances Nemesis, Rift Beast, and Exiled Mage encounters and expects that you are running Echoes normally and interacting with every mechanic that you find. Champions and Loot Lizards are the centerpiece of this strategy, which are buffed to provide a steady income of Exalted Items.

- Experience and Favor Farming
- The Experience and Favor Strategy is designed to optimize your push toward Max Level and bring in large amounts of Favor for interacting with the Circle of Fortune or Merchant's Guild mechanics. This strategy uses Lostwood Folly and Cemetery of Reweaving Woven Echo nests to create enemy density and a stable supply of Memory Amber to sustain it.

- Nemesis Farming
- The Nemesis Farming Weaver Tree focuses on increasing the number of Nemesis enemies encountered. This strategy heavily relies on using the Conquered Tower Woven Echo and Nemesis Echo Chains. Since this strategy puts Possessed Nemeses into Tombs and Cemeteries, other mechanics that benefit from these are also included. The Nemesis strategy is great for Players looking to find items with multiple Exalted stats or the Egg of the Forgotten for placing Legendary Potential on Uniques.

- Rift Beast Farming
- This Weaver Tree Strategy focuses on adding as many Rift Beast encounters as possible and bringing in a steady income of Primordial Materials. Since Rift Beast encounters don't spawn in Echoes with Tombs and Cemeteries, you limit the number of these that spawn and forgo mechanics that heavily benefit from them. The Rift Beast Farming Strategy is great for players who require certain Primordial Uniques or Exalted items for their build, or who enjoy farming this mechanic for the Item Crates purchased with Primordial Materials.

- Omen Window Farming
- The Omen Window Farming Strategy uses a steady supply of Omen Window Echo Chains to ensure that you always have access to Omen Windows. This is possible through a combination of Plentiful Windows, which makes them more common, and Memories of the Observer, which makes all of your normal Echoes into Echo Chains. This strategy is easy to use and sustain, but the content is very difficult. This strategy is great for players who want to heavily farm Omen Idols, Idol Altars, Corrupted Items, and Runes of Corruption, while also having a build that is geared for the content.

- Boss Farming
- The Boss Farming Weaver Tree is a flexible strategy that can be used for farming any major Boss that you choose. Which Boss you target can be changed on the fly by swapping between different Imprinted Woven Echoes, and fishing for them using the Memories of the Observer strategy. In the case of Dungeon Bosses, this Weaver Tree also includes ways to sustain Dungeon Keys and Portal Charms, and spawns Dungeon Enemies in your Echoes with the Warden's Echo Passive.

- Weaver's Will Unique Farming
- The Weaver's Will Unique Farming strategy makes items with Weaver's Will roll twice, and keep the highest value with the Prime Weaver Passive. It makes use of Lostwood Folly and Cemetery of Reweaving nests to encounter as many Woven Bosses as possible for Weaver's Will Unique drops. Since this strategy uses Tombs and Cemeteries, other mechanics that benefit from these are also included. The stats that get added to Weaver's Will Uniques are random, so this strategy is great for players who want to fully commit to finding the perfect Weaver's Will items for their build.

- Exiled Mage Farming
- The Exiled Mage Farming Strategy focuses on spawning as many Exiled Mages as possible. It uses the Memories of the Observer strategy to create Echo Chains to spawn Imprinted Rune Prison Complex Echoes. Other mechanics that benefit from increased Exiled Mages are also included. This strategy is great for players who are farming Experimental Items, Class-specific Affixes, or the Exiled Mage exclusive Uniques, such as Mad Alchemist's Ladle and Merophage.

## Starter Strategy

Weaver Tree Strategies
The Starter Strategy is tailored around unlocking your Weaver Tree Points as quickly as possible. You give your Champions a chance to drop Woven Echoes with Woven Fortunes, and make Champions appear more often to do so. This Starter Strategy also sets up generally useful Passives such as Imprints, Rift Beasts, and Nemesis Spawn Chance. The overall goal of this tree is to give you a strong early start while gathering Weaver Tree Points for more specific strategies.

### Starter Strategy Weaver Tree

Starter Strategy Weaver Tree

### How to Use This Tree

When using the Starter Strategy, Champions are your main targets. Champions spawn naturally in your Echoes, but also have a chance to spawn alongside Exiled Mages with The Mage Bane Passive. For this reason, it's important to check Rune Prisons for potential Champions when you have this Passive unlocked.

Tombs and Cemeteries are also important when using the Starter Strategy. First, they are another great source of the Woven Echoes you need for Weaver Tree Points. The Weaver Idols that drop from enemies inside are also important, as they are stronger than normal Idols, and can be crucial in the early stages of a Character for managing Resistances. With the Graveyard Prisons Passive allocated, Tombs and Cemeteries spawn guaranteed Rune Prisons, for more Exiled Mages and Champions.

In addition to Champions, the Starter Tree also supports the Nemesis mechanic. Nemeses are a great source of early items with multiple Exalted Stats, and a way to get Legendary Potential onto your first Uniques through the use of the Egg of the Forgotten.

#### Using Your Imprint Slots

The Echo Imprints in this tree are flexible, but False Temple, Conquered Tower, or Unclaimed Trove are recommended. False Temple is an enemy-dense Woven Echo, with many Shrines to help you farm it more efficiently. Conquered Tower is another good option if you want more Nemesis encounters. Unclaimed Trove is an Echo with many Lost Caches that can be great for spawning Loot Lizards, and easy access to random items and Crafting Materials. This Woven Echo must be used in Empowered, however, and takes away time from encountering Champions in Tombs and Cemeteries.

With the Starter Strategy, you also have access to Item Imprint Slots. The items you put into these slots are flexible and based heavily on what pieces of gear you are trying to improve or find more of. Item Imprinting is an extremely powerful form of progressing your gear, so don't neglect these Slots once you have them unlocked.

## General End Game Strategy

Weaver Tree Strategies
The General End Game Strategy focuses on a variety of generally useful mechanics. With this strategy, you run Echoes normally and interact with any mechanic you need along the way. Finally, this strategy uses Champions and Loot Lizards as a reliable source of Exalted Items.

### General End Game Weaver Tree

### How to Use This Tree

Since the General End Game Strategy expects you to farm several different mechanics, there are no specific strategies to use. This Weaver Tree is aimed at making sure those mechanics appear in your Echoes. You have increased Rift Beast encounters and access to Primordial Materials thanks to Age of Beasts and Riven Gateway. Nemesis encounters are more frequent with the Fated Nemesis Passive.

Champion enemies play a strong role in this Strategy, dropping more Exalted Items with Exalted Challenger and spawning Blue and Green Loot Lizards with Greedy Lizards. You increase our number of Champions with Dual Destruction and further boost your Loot Lizards with more Exalted Items using Lizard's Inheritance. This combination of Passives gives a steady supply of valuable item drops.

#### Woven Echo Imprints

The Woven Echo Imprint Slots in the General Endgame Tree are flexible and depend on what you need at the time.

Here are some examples of Woven Echoes you might choose to Imprint:

- False Temple
- An enemy-dense echo, with many Shrines and a simple layout. This is great for easily farming large amounts of general enemies.

- Unclaimed Trove
- A map filled with Lost Caches. This is great for activating your Sealed Riches Imprint, spawning Loot Lizards, and general item rewards and crafting materials.

- Conquered Tower
- This is the ideal Woven Echo to Imprint when you need more Nemesis Encounters. It can be used to fish for items with multiple Exalted Affixes, or Eggs of the Forgotten for a chance to add Legendary Potential to your Uniques.

- Rampant Coast
- Rampant Coast is recommended to be finished at least once for anyone looking to empower their Rift Beasts with an additional Evolution Slot. It is also a source of Crystallized Hearts. This Woven Echo has an extremely low spawn chance when Imprinted, though.

- Nesting Grove
- This is great for placing Rift Beast encounters into surrounding Echoes. It's worth considering when you are working toward a Primordial Item, or just want Primordial Materials to spend on loot Crates.

- Lostwood Folly
- Lostwood Folly fills surrounding maps with Weaver Enemies. This adds extra density to nearby Echoes and provides an additional source of Memory Amber income.

## Experience and Favor Farming

Weaver Tree Strategies
The Experience and Favor Farming Strategy uses Memories of the Observer to turn your normal Echoes into Echo Chains. This leaves space to spawn Cemetery of Reweaving Imprints to start building Woven Echo nests for farming as early as possible into your Echo Web.

### Experience and Favor Weaver Tree

### How to Use This Tree

When using the Experience and Favor Farming Weaver Tree, your first goal is to push to a Corruption level that you can farm efficiently. Use Temporal Keystone to fight your Timeline Boss for Gaze of Orobyss, to boost the amount of Corruption your Shades give. The higher your Corruption, the more Experience and Favor your enemies give.

Once you reach your desired Corruption level, your focus switches to building nests of Woven Echoes for farming. Lostwood Folly and Cemetery of Reweaving are the important Woven Echoes for this strategy. The goal is to build a straight line of Lostwood Folly, then Cemetery of Reweaving, one after the other. Then, fill in the spaces surrounding each Lostwood Folly with more Cemetery of Reweaving. This creates a nest of Woven Echoes.

This strategy achieves two things. First, Lostwood Folly places more enemies into the surrounding Cemetery of Reweaving Echoes. This creates more density, and more Experience and Favor. Second, Cemetery of Reweaving is a reliable source of Memory Amber, which helps sustain this strategy. You purchase more Lostwood Folly and Cemetery of Reweaving Woven Echoes from The Woven Faction as needed with the Memory Amber you acquire.

When running your Cemetery of Reweaving maps, be sure to fully clear them. Run your Echo until you find the Cemetery, enter it, and clear it. At the end of your completed Cemetery, there is an Exit back to where you first entered. From here, clear the rest of your Echo before leaving. This makes sure that you take full advantage of your extra enemy packs and get as much Memory Amber returned as possible.

False Temple is a notable replacement for Cemetery of Reweaving. The False Temple usually contains Increased Experience Gain Shrines and is generally faster to complete, but rewards less Memory Amber overall.

#### Woven Echo Imprints

Lostwood Folly and Cemetery of Reweaving are your chosen Woven Echo Imprints with this Strategy. Cemetery of Reweaving is the most important, as finding one early allows you to begin quickly building your Woven Echo nests.

Lostwood Folly as an Imprint has the potential to save you the Memory Amber cost of purchasing one, by providing you a starting point in fresh Echo Webs.

## Nemesis Farming

Waver Tree Strategies
The Nemesis Farming Weaver Tree fills your maps with Nemesis encounters and spawns Conquered Tower Imprints with the Memories of the Observer Strategy. This Weaver Tree setup also spawns extra Tombs and Cemeteries of the Erased, which contain Possessed Nemesis enemies thanks to Warden of the Dead. Your spare Weaver Tree points set up Champions as a source of Exalted items.

### Nemesis Weaver Tree

### How to Use This Tree

The Nemesis Farming Weaver Tree Strategy makes use of Memories of the Observer to create Echo Chains on your Echo Web. Imprint a Conquered Tower Woven Echo as soon as possible, so it can begin spawning in your Echo Web. From this point, run your Echoes as usual and look for Nemesis encounters. Prioritize Tombs and Cemeteries, since they guarantee a Nemesis encounter with the Warden of the Dead Passive. Run Conquered Tower when it spawns into your Echo Web.

With the Memories of the Observer Strategy, your Imprinted Conquered Tower has plenty of space to spawn near the created Echo Chains. The chance of spawning Imprinted Echoes becomes less likely as you begin to progress past 10 Echoes in a row. For this reason, it's important to reset your Echo Web using the Sanctuary of Eterra when you've pushed to this point in every direction. This ensures that you have a steady supply of Conquered Tower spawning. Supplement these Imprint spawns by placing your own Conquered Tower Woven Echoes when completing a Cemetery of the Erased.

With this strategy, it's not efficient to reset your Echo Web frequently for Conquered Tower spawns. Nemesis encounters are common enough in Echoes that it's faster to run them normally and look for Conquered Towers as you progress. When you reach 10 Echoes in each direction, it is worth resetting your Echo Web then, since Shade of Orobyss Echoes begin competing with Imprinted Echo spawns.

#### Woven Echo Imprints

For this strategy, Imprinting Conquered Tower is mandatory. Since you don't benefit from having two Conquered Towers Imprinted, your second Imprint Slot is flexible. Increasing your number of Tombs and Cemeteries to access Possessed Nemesis encounters makes Rift Beasts less frequent. For this reason, Bloodline Glade is recommended as a passive source of Primordial Materials. False Temple is another option, since it requires minimal setup and is safe and easy to clear.

#### Using Echo Chains

Nemesis Echo Chains are also an important source of Conquered Tower Woven Echoes. Prioritize these Echo Chains whenever you see them for a guaranteed Nemesis encounter in each, and a free Conquered Tower Echo at the end. Spawn more of these types of Echo Chains by spending Timeglass Fragments at the end of Greater Omen Windows by interacting with the Timeglass Core. Find Greater Omen Windows at the end of Omen Window Echo Chains.

## Rift Beast Farming

Weaver Tree Strategies
The Rift Beast Farming Strategy leverages every possible Rift Beast Passive available to increase how often you encounter them. With this strategy, you run Echoes as normal, completing Rift Beast encounters and slaying Rift Beast ambushes from Primordial Ambush. Since Rift Beasts don't spawn in Arena Echoes or maps with Tombs and Cemeteries, you limit how often you encounter these, as well as mechanics that rely on them. For Imprints, you use Nesting Grove to add Rift Beast encounters to surrounding Echoes, and the more rare Rampant Coast for Crystallized Hearts.

### Rift Beast Weaver Tree

### How to Use This Tree

For this Weaver Tree Strategy, run your Echoes normally, completing Rift Beast encounters as you find them. Rift Beasts encounters have increased spawn chance with Age of Beasts. Primordial Ambush adds Rift Beast ambushes to your Echoes. During this process, look for Rift Beast Echo Chains and your Imprinted Nesting Grove or Rampant Coast.

When you find an Imprinted Nesting Grove on your Echo Web, prioritize running it first, since completing it adds guaranteed Rift Beast encounters to surrounding Echoes. If you have access to a Cemetery on your Echo Web, complete it first to place more Woven Echoes around the Nesting Grove, if there is empty space around it. This ensures that you have access to the maximum number of Rift Beast encounters spawned by the Nesting Grove.

Since Rift Beasts are unable to spawn in Echoes containing Tombs and Cemeteries, when you encounter one of these mechanics, you know that it's safe to leave the Echo upon completion without missing a Rift Beast encounter. For this reason, this Weaver Tree Strategy also avoids adding extra Tombs and Cemeteries or mechanics that rely on them. Buying Bags of Memory Amber from Skarven Bloodhorn is an option with any leftover Primordial Materials you acquire to help with Memory Amber income.

#### Woven Echo Imprints

This strategy Imprints Nesting Grove and Rampant Coast. Nesting Groves that spawn within your Echo Web add guaranteed Rift Beast encounters to surrounding Echoes. Rampant Coast features a Rift Beast encounter with a guaranteed Crystallized Heart drop, along with other Primordial Materials. It's important to note that Rampant Coast has an extremely low chance to spawn on your Echo Web when Imprinted. For this reason, Bloodline Glade is a viable alternative for Imprinting if you care less about Crystallized Hearts and want more frequent general Primordial Materials. Bloodline Glade contains randomly evolved Rift Beasts, which all drop Primordial Materials.

#### Using Echo Chains

Rift Beast Echo Chains are a consistent source of Rift Beast encounters. Prioritize these Echo Chains whenever you see them for a guaranteed Rift Beast encounter in each Echo of the Chain. Spawn more of these types of Echo Chains by spending Timeglass Fragments at the end of Greater Omen Windows by interacting with the Timeglass Core. Find Greater Omen Windows at the end of Omen Window Echo Chains.

## Omen Window Farming

Weaver Tree Strategies
This strategy increases your access to Omen Windows by using the Plentiful Windows Passive to make Omen Window Echo Chains more common. Meanwhile, Inescapable Omens adds roaming Omen enemies to your Echoes. The Omen Window Farming strategy runs sustainable Omen's Veil Woven Echoes, with an alternative option to use Memories of the Observer to quickly and reliably find Omen Window Echo Chains.

### Omen Window Weaver Tree

### How to Use This Tree

The most optimal way to use this strategy is to run Omen's Veil Woven Echoes. Simply run Echoes until you find an early Cemetery of the Erased, and place as many Omen's Veils as you can and run them. The Timeglass Fragments you collect from doing this allow you to purchase more Omen's Veils from Apophis the Oracle at the center of the Monolith Hub. Each Omen's Veil contains three guaranteed Omen Windows.

As an alternative, when you want to run Echoes naturally, this strategy also supports Omen Window Echo Chains. The Memories of the Observer Passive turns your Echoes into Echo Chains, which have a chance to be Omen Window Chains. First, check your Echo Chains for any Omen Window Chains to run. If your Echo Web has no Omen Window Chains, reset it using Sanctuary of Eterra to generate more. The Echo Imprints used by this strategy are flexible and only intended to support your needs beyond the Omen Window mechanic. For this reason, it is safe to continue pushing out your Echo Web as long as you have Omen Window Echo Chains available.

#### Woven Echo Imprints

The Omen Window Farming Weaver Tree has easy access to Omen Window encounters through Echo Chains. Because of this, your Imprinted Woven Echoes are less important. The most useful is Omen's Veil, which contains three Greater Omen Windows. Beyond this, the final Echo Imprint is flexible. Use it to include Woven Echoes supporting mechanics you need more of at the time. Some examples are Nesting Grove to create more Rift Beast encounters, Conquered Tower for Nemeses, or Cemetery of Reweaving for easy access to the Cemeteries and Memory Amber.

## Boss Farming

Weaver Tree Strategies
The Boss Farming Weaver Tree Strategy is useful for farming all types of Boss Uniques. Your Woven Echo Imprints allow you to switch focus between different major Bosses on the fly. This strategy uses Memories of the Observer to create Echo Chains with space for your Imprinted Woven Echoes. This method allows you to quickly reset your Echo Web to fish for them. In the case of Dungeon Bosses, this Weaver Tree provides increased Dungeon Keys and Dungeon Enemies in Echoes. The Dungeon Enemies in your Echoes have a chance to drop the loot of their associated Dungeon Boss.

### Boss Farming Weaver Tree

### How to Use This Tree

This Weaver Tree's strategy changes heavily depending on which Boss you are targeting. It supports farming Timeline Bosses, Harbingers, Shade of Orobyss, Arena Champions, and Majasa. Each Boss uses a different Imprinted Woven Echo and employs different playstyles.

#### Timeline Boss and Harbinger Focus

When focused on farming specific Uniques from Timeline Bosses or Harbingers, Collapsing Horizon is your most important Woven Echo to Imprint. This Echo contains a Harbinger from the Timeline you are currently in, and drops loot from its own pool as well as from the Timeline's Boss. The goal is to check your Echo Web for the Imprinted Collapsing Horizon to spawn. If it's not there, reset your Echo Web using the Sanctuary of Eterra Echo and try again. Repeat this strategy as often as needed.

The Fading Brink is an extremely difficult way to supplement this strategy, and is included in your Woven Echo Imprints. This is a fight against all ten Harbingers, one after another. Because of this, The Fading Brink provides an additional opportunity at loot, as long as your build can handle the difficulty.

As a variation to this style of farming, you can also target Timeline Bosses directly by instantly filling your Stability with Temporal Keystones. This Weaver Tree includes support for Champions, which are sometimes accompanied by Green Loot Lizards. Green Loot Lizards are rare, but have a chance to drop more Temporal Keystones to supply this method. This method is slower and requires pushing out your Echo Web for Stability when you run out of Temporal Keystones.

Quote

Check our Monolith Hub for Guides on each Timeline Boss and Harbinger.

#### Shade of Orobyss Focus

When farming Shade of Orobyss, Confluence of Oblivion is your Woven Echo Imprint of choice. This encounter contains five Shades of Orobyss, each with its own chance to drop loot. To use this strategy, be sure to imprint a Confluence of Oblivion, then reset your Echo Web using Sanctuary of Eterra. If no Confluence of Oblivion Woven Echoes spawn, use Sanctuary of Eterra to reset your Echo Web and try again. Repeat this strategy as often as needed.

## Weaver's Will Unique Farming

Weaver Tree Strategies
The Weaver's Will Farming Strategy uses Prime Weaver and Woven Treasures to boost the amount and quality of Weaver's Will Uniques that drop. Prime Weaver rolls the amount of Weaver's Will an item drops with twice, and keeps the higher value. Woven Treasures gives all Rare enemies in your maps a chance to drop Weaver's Will Uniques. This Strategy uses nests of Lostwood Folly and Cemetery of Reweaving Woven Echoes to encounter Woven Bosses as often as possible while sustaining Memory Amber.

### Weaver's Will Weaver Tree

### How to Use This Tree

This Weaver Tree strategy relies on encountering as many Woven Bosses as possible. This creates a steady supply of Weaver's Will Unique Drops. The most efficient way to set this up is to create Echo nests of Lostwood Folly surrounded by Cemetery of Reweaving.

In order to set this up, complete a Cemetery of the Erased, and begin by placing a Lostwood Folly Woven Echo, followed by a Cemetery of Reweaving, and then repeat the process until you have a long string of Echoes. Once this is complete, place Cemetery of Reweaving in all of the empty spaces surrounding the Lostwood Folly Woven Echoes.

Lostwood Folly has three Woven Boss enemies that each have a chance to drop Weaver's Will Uniques. It then adds Woven enemies into the surrounding Cemeteries of Reweaving, which helps sustain your Memory Amber for purchasing more Woven Echoes when the cycle is complete. The Cemetery of Reweaving itself also contains Woven Bosses, for more chances at Weaver's Will Uniques.

#### Woven Echo Imprints

Since you are building your own Echo Web full of nests, Woven Echo Imprints are less important here. A Lostwood Folly that gets Imprinted into your map can provide a good starting point for building your nest, and saves the Memory Amber cost of purchasing one yourself. Finding an early Imprinted Cemetery of Reweaving gives you quick access to an altar to begin placing Woven Echoes yourself, if you haven't already found a Cemetery.

## Exiled Mage Farming

Weaver Tree Strategies
The Exiled Mage Farming Strategy focuses on spawning as many Exiled Mage encounters as possible. You accomplish this by using the Memories of the Observer strategy to frequently attempt to spawn the Imprinted Rune Prison Complex. This strategy also takes advantage of the guaranteed Exiled Mages in Tombs and Cemeteries with Graveyard Prisons. Also, it has a chance to double your Exiled Mages with Exiled But Not Forgotten. This is an excellent way to collect Experimental Items, Class Specific Affix Shards, and exclusive Uniques such as Mad Alchemist's Ladle and Merophage.

### Exiled Mage Weaver Tree

### How to Use This Tree

The first priority for this strategy is obtaining a Rune Prison Complex Woven Echo if you do not already have one. Since this Woven Echo is rare and drop-only, Imprinting one adds a consistent source of them to your Echo Webs. Exiled Mages at Area Level 90+ have a 1-2% chance to drop theRune Prison Complex based on Corruption level.

The most efficient use of this Weaver Tree capitalizes on the Imprinted Rune Prison Complex. Memories of the Observer creates more visible space on your Echo Web to check for immediate Rune Prison Complex spawns. If no Rune Prison Complex is available, reset your Web using the Sanctuary of Eterra and try again. Repeat this as many times as you desire.

Running your Echoes as normal is a less efficient alternative to this. Exiled Mage encounters are common enough in regular Echoes, however, that you still encounter a reliable amount. Make use of the guaranteed Exiled Mage spawns in Tombs in Cemeteries as you progress. When farming in this way, prioritize your Rune Prison Complex as they spawn naturally onto your Echo Web. It's important to reset your Echo Web once you reach 10 completed Echoes in every direction. This is because Shade of Orobyss Echoes begin to compete with Rune Prison Complex Imprint spawns.

#### Woven Echo Imprints

Rune Prison Complex is mandatory for this strategy to function at its highest potential. Since this Woven Echo is quite rare, Imprinting it increases how often you can run it. Additionally, since this strategy uses increased Tombs and Cemeteries, you encounter Rift Beasts less frequently. For this reason, you use Bloodline Glade as a source of more Primordial Materials.
